summary: Brooks County, Georgia, lookout tower filed under Florida on the Forest Lookouts site. Coordinates from Georgia lists; no build, height or current condition found.

corrections.why: The Georgia list and Mapcarta both place the tower in Brooks County, Georgia. Only the Forest Lookouts Florida index places it in Florida, and that page names no state for the tower.
The current value is a round number that does not match the Georgia list or Mapcarta, which both give 30.70048.
The Georgia list and Mapcarta both give -83.5946.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts index files the tower under Florida, but the county it gives is Brooks, which the Georgia list and Mapcarta place in Georgia. The story follows the Georgia sources.

notes_for_editor: Duplicate record: data/towers/ga/us-ga-catledge-hill.json (tnlandforms GA013) describes the same tower. Suggest merging the two IDs and hiding the FL record. Two directory pages (Chamber of Commerce listing and anyplaceamerica topo page) name a Catledge Hill Lookout Tower in Quitman, GA; both returned 403 and were not read, so nothing from them is used. Only location is sourced here; a current-condition check (satellite imagery or Georgia Forestry Commission) is needed before any statement about standing or access.
